title: Antiproliferative Activity of Antibiotics through DNA Binding Mechanism: Evaluation and Molecular Docking Studies.
authors: Magklaras, Alexandros-Dimitrios C; Banti, Christina N; Hadjikakou, Sotiris K
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过UV-Vis、粘度测量和分子对接评估三种抗生素与DNA的结合及抗增殖活性，虽涉及DNA结合和分子对接，但对象为小分子抗生素而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且方法简单，与TF-DNA课题关联有限。
abstract: The antiproliferative activity of three antibiotics clinically use, was studied through DNA inhibition mechanisms, ex vivo, in silico and in vitro. The ex vivo interaction of DNA with ciprofloxacin hydrochloride (CIP.HCl), penicillin G sodium salt (PEN.Na), and tetracycline hydrochloride (TC.HCl) was determined by UV-Vis spectra and viscosity measurements. Furthermore, their binding constants (K(b)) toward CT-DNA were calculated (K(b) = (2.8 +/- 0.6) x 10(4) (CIP.HCl), (0.4 +/- 0.1) x 10(4) (PEN.Na) and (6.9 +/- 0.3) x 10(4) (TC.HCl) Mu(-1)). Docking studies on the binding interactions of antibiotics with DNA were performed to rationalize the ex vivo results. The in vitro antiproliferative activity of the antibiotics was evaluated against human breast adenocarcinoma (MCF-7) cells (IC(50) values: 417.4 +/- 28.2 (CIP.HCl), >2000 (PEN.Na) and 443.1 +/- 17.2 (TC.HCl) muMu). Cell cycle arrest studies confirmed the apoptotic type of MCF-7 cells. The toxicity of the studied agents was in vitro tested against human fetal lung fibroblast cells (MRC-5). The results are compared with the corresponding one for doxorubicin (DOX). Despite their low binding affinity to DNA (K(b)) or their different mode of interaction, TC.HCl (anthracycline) or CIP.HCl (quinolones), exhibit notable antiproliferative activity and low toxicity.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过DNA抑制机制，在离体（ex vivo）、计算机模拟（in silico）和体外（in vitro）条件下，探讨了三种临床使用抗生素的抗增殖活性。通过紫外-可见光谱和粘度测量，确定了环丙沙星盐酸盐（CIP.HCl）、青霉素G钠盐（PEN.Na）和四环素盐酸盐（TC.HCl）与DNA的离体相互作用。此外，计算了它们与CT-DNA的结合常数（K(b)），分别为（2.8 ± 0.6）× 10^4（CIP.HCl）、（0.4 ± 0.1）× 10^4（PEN.Na）和（6.9 ± 0.3）× 10^4（TC.HCl）M^-1。为合理化离体结果，进行了抗生素与DNA结合相互作用的对接研究。体外抗增殖活性评估针对人乳腺癌（MCF-7）细胞进行，其IC(50)值分别为：417.4 ± 28.2（CIP.HCl）、>2000（PEN.Na）和443.1 ± 17.2（TC.HCl）μM。细胞周期阻滞研究证实了MCF-7细胞的凋亡类型。所研究药物的毒性在体外对人胚肺成纤维细胞（MRC-5）进行了测试。结果与阿霉素（DOX）的相应数据进行了比较。尽管TC.HCl（蒽环类）或CIP.HCl（喹诺酮类）对DNA的结合亲和力（K(b)）较低或相互作用模式不同，但它们表现出显著的抗增殖活性和低毒性。
